audit.whatIsWrong: tldr called Akali an 'AD assassin' that 'skips your shield', and dontsFull[0].d implied she outranges Null Sphere.
audit.why: Riot's text has Shuriken Flip dealing magic damage and Five Point Strike scaling off bonus AD and AP; Kassadin's passive reduces magic damage and Null Sphere's shield absorbs it. Range-wise Five Point Strike is 550 to Null Sphere's 650 — she does NOT outrange your Q. Shuriken Flip at 825 is what actually reaches you.
audit.corrected: tldr, tradeGood and dontsFull[0].d now state the real ranges and damage type.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was the generic Kassadin clock line and never named Perfect Execution.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is 120/90/60 — the ult cooldown halving from 120 to 60 is the real Akali spike, and Twilight Shroud goes 20s to 16s and costs no energy.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes, breakdown.carry, phases[4].why and phases[5].why now key off those numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and wants.foe[1] both claim Twilight Shroud 'dodges your Q Null Sphere silence'. Null Sphere does not silence in Riot's text — it interrupts channels. And the reason Shroud beats it is stronger than 'dodging': inside the shroud she is untargetable, so a single-target ability cannot be cast at her at all.
audit.why: Riot: Null Sphere 'fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and interrupting channels'. Riot: Twilight Shroud makes Akali 'invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks'.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to say untargetable, and the false silence removed. Also added: Force Pulse charges off her casts, and Five Point Strike's 1.5s cooldown charges it fast.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); dosFull[2].d called Shroud a 'fifteen-second' cooldown.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16 — never fifteen. Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, Perfect Execution 120/90/60.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into both fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t says 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' — Akali has no healing in her kit text, and the pronoun is wrong.
audit.why: Nothing in Assassin's Mark, Five Point Strike, Twilight Shroud, Shuriken Flip or Perfect Execution heals. The real defensive buy against an execute recast is Zhonya's.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal clause replaced with the Zhonya's timing.
sources: brief.enemyKit (no heal flag on any slot)

audit.whatIsWrong: 14 lint findings: Akali repeatedly called he/his/him, plus dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Akali is she/her per champ-gender.js; the bullets promised 'E-slow her engage' and 'Greed stacks in her kill windows' and explained neither.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields rewritten with bodies matching their titles.

audit.why: 54.69% over 1631 games; no elo split written.
